text:
sam: quick sync on the adaptive admission & probe safety idea i prototyped. trying to marry tenant crediting with microburst probes so probing can't be abused and we can account for packing wins/losses.

ivy: high-level please — how is crediting used?

sam: tenants get an admission_credit balance that reflects recent packing efficiency. when a probe opens we charge a small probe_credit. if probe promotes to normal, we refund a portion and add a packing_reward. if probe fails (evicted/no pack), charge is kept and a failure_penalty cooldown increases.

carl: sounds like token-bucket + economic incentives. how do we compute packing_reward?

sam: reward = min( max_reward, base * (packed_tokens / requested_tokens) ). essentially proportional to how much the probe helped packing vs wasted. base and max_reward are tunables. also we decay credits over time to avoid hoarding.

mei: operational concerns: how do we avoid noisy tenants draining global capacity by repeatedly spending credits?

sam: couple of defenses: 1) global_probe_inflight_limit per pool, 2) per-tenant probe_rate_limit (refill slower when failures high), 3) short-term blacklist if probe_failure_rate > threshold. blacklist duration grows exponentially.

ivy: need observability hooks. what metrics/labels do we emit?

sam: emit probe.open, probe.promote, probe.fail, tenant.credit_balance, tenant.probe_fail_rate, tenant.packing_reward_sum. label spans with tenant_id, probe_token_cost, credit_delta. also heatmap: tenant.credit_balance over time.

carl: API changes? admission call signature?

sam: minimal: optional header X-Admission-Mode: probe|promote|normal and X-Tenant-Credit-Token if controller wants to pre-authorize spending. controllers not using credits default to normal flow.

mei: what's the rollback/short-circuit plan if this affects p99?

sam: rollout plan: feature-flag gated at runtime (+ per-pool flag). short-circuit knob: admission.probe.enabled = false which makes all probe attempts treat as normal admission. emergency action: set global_probe_inflight_limit=0 which effectively disables probes. oncall-bot: will post when short-circuit is toggled.

oncall-bot: reminder: add alert probe_failure_rate_pool > 10% for 5m.

ivy: how about KV warmups? earlier we saw warmup thrash when probes become normal.

sam: probes still marked no-kv. on promotion we run a non-blocking prefetch step. if prefetch latency spikes, we drop the promotion and count it as failure to avoid cascading warmups. also add prefetched_kv_metric.

carl: performance tradeoffs? i.e., net throughput vs packing efficiency.

sam: expected: small boost in throughput for highly microbursty tenants, neutral/slight regress for sustained heavy streams. credits help bias probes toward tenants that historically pack well. we should run 2x canaries: one on microburst-heavy traffic shape, one on sustained heavy shape.

mei: config snippet?

sam: ``
admission.probe.enabled = true
admission.probe.cost_token = 1
admission.probe.refund_ratio = 0.6
admission.probe.cooldown_base_ms = 50
admission.probe.cooldown_mult = 2.0
admission.probe.global_inflight_limit = 150
admission.tenant.credit_decay_ms = 300000
admission.tenant.max_credit = 100
``

ivy: action items?

sam: 1) implement credit ledger + metrics (owner: sam)
 2) dashboard: tenant_credit_balance, probe_open_rate, probe_success_rate, prefetched_kv_rate (owner: ivy)
 3) add admission headers to client lib + doc (owner: carl)
 4) short canary (10% pool) with microburst-heavy traffic tomorrow (owner: mei)

mei: I'll also add runbook entries: what to flip and where to check metrics/traces.

carl: include sample traces for refund vs no-refund paths (2% sampling).

ivy: +1. let's be careful with metric cardinality — use tenant sampling for high-cardinality metrics.

sam: noted. will submit a small RFC stub linking to this thread and the config. thanks all.
